Metal Slug 系列真的是我童年最燒錢的街機遊戲之一。

以前撲滿裡那些 10 元硬幣，
名義上是存錢，實際上都是在幫老闆繳營業額。

小時候玩這遊戲的日常大概是：
投 10 元 → 帥氣開場 → 30 秒後死亡 → 看著剩下的 0 命開始思考人生
然後還是會默默再投一枚。

它最誇張的是，美術放到現在看居然還是超強。

那種美式卡通風格、爆炸特效、角色動作，
每一幀都像：「製作組是不是拿命在畫像素？」

尤其角色被炸飛、坦克爆炸、敵人士兵尖叫逃跑的細節，現在看還是很有靈魂。

而且這遊戲很神奇：
操作明明超簡單，但你總能玩得像戰神，或像剛學會走路的人。

有時候帥到：蹲下 → 丟手榴彈 → 空中射擊 → 完美清場

有時候則是：看到敵人 → 緊張 → 按錯鍵 → 原地被炸死

最快樂的還是找隱藏僕從。
每次打牆壁突然跳出一個人質，
內心都會有種：「我果然是天選之人，這秘密只有我知道。」
然後下一秒拿到香蕉 !!!

長大後重玩最感動的是：
遊戲其實沒什麼變，變的是以前那個可以在街機前玩一整個下午的自己。

以前是：「再一局啦！」

現在是：「我等等還要忙其他事情……」

所以這遊戲最棒的地方不只是好玩，而是它像一台時光機。

音樂一響、畫面一出來，你會突然想起以前那個：
口袋只有幾枚硬幣，卻覺得自己可以拯救世界的小孩。

Metal Slug is a timeless arcade masterpiece that somehow feels even better today than it did back then. Playing it again for the first time since a pool hall arcade 20+ years ago, I was honestly blown away - it didn’t just hold up, it exceeded my memory of it. The pixel art is absolutely top-tier, packed with detail, humor, and fluid animation that still puts modern games to shame. Gameplay is tight, fast, and endlessly satisfying, with that perfect balance of chaos and control that makes every run exciting.

The variety is another huge strength - different weapons, vehicles, enemy types, and set pieces keep things fresh from start to finish, even in its relatively short runtime. And that’s the beauty of it: it’s designed for replayability, encouraging you to jump back in and improve every time.

It’s pure arcade magic - simple to pick up, tough to master, and ridiculously fun the entire way through. SNK absolutely nailed it with this one, and it remains one of the best run & gun games ever made.

Reseña de METAL SLUG

Metal Slug es uno de los arcades más icónicos y queridos de la historia. SNK creó una mezcla perfecta de acción frenética, humor absurdo y pixel art espectacular que terminó definiendo completamente el género run and gun durante los años 90.

La historia sigue a los soldados Marco Rossi y Tarma Roving mientras enfrentan al ejército rebelde liderado por el General Morden en una guerra llena de explosiones, vehículos y caos constante.

Uno de los mayores puntos fuertes es el gameplay extremadamente divertido y rápido. Desde el primer minuto el juego te obliga a reaccionar constantemente mientras disparas y esquivas enormes cantidades de enemigos.

La variedad de armas también ayuda muchísimo a mantener la acción entretenida. Heavy Machine Gun, Rocket Launcher, Shotgun y Flame Shot son algunas de las armas más icónicas de la saga.

El gran protagonista igualmente es el Metal Slug, un pequeño tanque extremadamente poderoso y divertido de controlar que se volvió símbolo de la franquicia.

Visualmente el juego sigue siendo impresionante incluso hoy. El pixel art tiene un nivel de detalle y animación increíble para la época.

Las explosiones, expresiones faciales y pequeñas animaciones caricaturescas le dan muchísima personalidad al juego.

La música arcade energética también acompaña perfectamente la acción frenética.

Otro aspecto genial es el humor absurdo constante. A pesar de estar ambientado en una guerra, el tono siempre mantiene estilo caricaturesco y exagerado.

Sin embargo, la dificultad es bastante alta, especialmente para jugadores nuevos.

Las partidas pueden terminar rápidamente si no memorizas patrones enemigos y ataques de jefes.

Además, como muchos arcades clásicos, la duración es relativamente corta.

Algunas ralentizaciones también aparecen en momentos llenos de enemigos, especialmente en versiones originales.

Aun así, METAL SLUG sigue siendo una verdadera leyenda arcade y uno de los shooters 2D más importantes y entretenidos jamás creados.

Hello Friends,

Today I will review the game METAL SLUG. Originally it came out on a NEO GEO gaming machines in arcades. These were the arcade cases where you put coins in to increase time in a game, not to buy extra lives. They used this arcade machine lots in the late 1990's. This version on steam includes multiplayer, but good luck finding a game unless you have a friend who also wants to play with you. The game is like the original arcade version, but when i personally played it, the music stuttered a bit and sounded odd to me, like it was not matching the tempo of when your playing in the game.

PROS:

- The original arcade version, ported to steam.

- Multiplayer functionality to play with others.

- Game is easy to get all achievements just by playing thru the game. Personally, it took me 3 hours to get all the level ones.

- Works fine with controllers. I used a NEO ZEN Nintendo switch 1 controller.

- Works on windows 11 OS system.


CONS:

- I heard the music not synching correctly on my pc. It sounded like it was lagging in the background or stuttering for some reason.

- Find a person who plays with you in multiplayer to get the achievement can be difficult. Some steam posters have actually posted on the forums about helping others. You can look here to see it:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/366250/discussions/0/640179446900330861/

It's a shame that this port is so questionable, [b]Metal Slug[/b] would deserve a much better way to be played on PC legally. But even that can't hide its quality, still shining 30 years later. In an era with an obsession over the rising 3D graphics (at least in the West), SNK did instead double down on the Neo Geo's 2D capabilities. 
The pixel art hasn't aged a day since I first experienced the game in Spring of 1996, every time you play you can spot new details in the backgrounds, in the amazing animations, in the fantastic vehicle design, topped by a style that reminds me a lot of European comics, making it look like some playable cartoon with equal parts of hilarity and brutality. Not to speak of the sound, with one of the most iconic music themes in videogames, and even more iconic voice clips.

Due to its arcade origin the challenge is sometimes unbalanced no matter the difficulty level, and the final boss battle feels a bit underwhelming, compared to the previous bosses and the grueling final mission that precedes it, but it can't change that [b]Metal Slug[/b] stands the test of time as one of the quintessential 2D games and action games at once.

La Facultad de Filosofía y Letras de la udg le otorgó el Premio Adalberto Navarro Sánchez en 1987. Obtuvo el Premio Internacional Navachiste en 1994 por la Universidad Autónoma de Sinaloa uas. Recibió en 1991 la beca Jóvenes Creadores del Fondo Nacional para la Cultura y las Artes fonca. Desde 1997, es miembro del Sistema Nacional de Investigadores nivel iii.[/u]
